content.comment_body: Hello, can anyone assist? I am building a simple machine that mixes two liquids—a solvent and an adhesive—and want to use a [product_name] module plus an operator panel to calculate and show the mix ratio. Each liquid is measured by flow meters, providing pulses indicating specific quantities. I need to measure the pulse frequency and calculate the flow rate in millilitres per minute for each liquid, then determine their ratio. I plan to manually control the pumps to adjust proportions. The math function, however, does not accept pulse frequency, so I am unable to proceed. My program is attached; I think I am missing something and would appreciate help on how to approach this. Many thanks, [user_name].
Thank you, that helps a lot. I couldn’t find this explanation elsewhere.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users faced issues incorporating mathematical instructions in [product_name] engineering software to process flow meter pulse frequencies and calculate mixture ratios. This reflects a gap in documentation and clarity regarding handling frequency inputs and configuring references between logic blocks. The guidance provided through relevant documentation was well received, illustrating that better access to instructions resolves confusion quickly.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward input of frequency data from flow meters into [product_name] engineering software’s mathematical functions, simple calculation of flow rates, and easy display of mixture ratios on the relevant operator panel.
